meta.about: A rename inside a code pane that adds a character. The 140-limit guards slide text that can overflow, not a pane that scrolls.
meta.recorded-outcome: "replace the text JavaScript with BooyaScript" on slide 11, once the subtitle had already been renamed, refused with `Replacing "JavaScript" in 11.2 would make it 570 characters; anything over 140 overflows the slide.` The pane was already 569 and rendering fine — `.code-frame pre` is `overflow: auto` inside a capped frame, so its text scrolls at any length. The old rule was `after > MAX_TEXT && after > before`, which let a node already past the limit be edited only if the edit added no characters at all; BooyaScript is one letter longer than JavaScript.
meta.guards: the `before.length <= MAX_TEXT` clause in `planReplace`. Put back `after.length > before.length` and the replace touches one node instead of two, and the receipt carries a `Skipped:` line naming 11.2.

turns.ask: replace the text JavaScript with BooyaScript
